site.$comment_platforms: Third-party platform names banned on the public storefront (Lot F-2c C-4 / ADR-M004 D14): product wiring is described generically ('a lending venue', 'a perp DEX'), never by a partner/protocol brand. Unambiguous brands use a plain \b word boundary. UMA and Gamma carry a STRICT \b...\b boundary so substrings (human, summary, Pendleton) do not false-positive; note the gate compiles case-insensitive, so the standalone options-greek word 'gamma' in prose WOULD match — a known limit declared for checkpoint-2 alongside the ambiguous 'Safe' (deliberately NOT listed: it is a common English word AND a multisig brand; manual review per lot). Adding a name = this ADR line. Live mutant proof: docs/G1-lot-F2c.md.
